description: Credentialless, disposable, pre-kickoff study of PM2 7.0.3 and Pi supervision. Planning closes through current critic re-review, exact validation, and an artifact-only draft PR; a distinct explicit-human-kickoff gate blocks all implementation. Outputs are evidence and uncertainty only, with no adoption, recommendation, production configuration, or production mutation.

executionContract: Implementation is forbidden until the distinct US-002 explicit-human-kickoff gate passes from a new, unambiguous human authorization after US-001; authorization is never inferred
All benchmark, process-launch, fault-injection, and PM2 work uses a mktemp runtime root; task artifacts and read-only source inspection are the only exemptions

Never execute or load production bridge, recovery extension, settings, scripts, config, state, locks, logs, tmux sessions, or gateway runtime; metadata-only pre/post snapshots use git status/diff path names, tmux session identity, and process identity without reading production content

Never edit production scripts/config, Docker/devcontainer files, manifests, lockfiles, settings, images, sessions, or runtime; never replace/remove tmux; never use PM2 cluster/modules/startup/save/resurrect, global install, added dependencies, persistent dump/service/daemon, or production configuration

Spawn runtime children from env -i with only PATH, HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_STATE_HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME, TMPDIR, LANG=C.UTF-8, LC_ALL=C.UTF-8, TZ=UTC, and manifest-listed fixture non-secrets; HOME/XDG/TMP and mode-0700 PM2_HOME are fresh runtime-root children; no ambient values or auth stores are read, copied, inventoried, or mounted

Negative preflight rejects prohibited credential-key patterns, escaping allowlisted paths, or non-empty disposable auth/config homes; it inspects only the constructed child environment, never ambient values

Deny outbound network or mark the candidate NOT RUN; the sole setup exception is exact https://registry.npmjs.org/pm2/-/pm2-7.0.3.tgz with pinned integrity, no auth/config, and offline dependency resolution; any other fetch or cache miss is NOT RUN

Use only synthetic data and a deterministic local fake/test provider under denied network; if that cannot avoid credential discovery and a live/provider-backed model turn, the extension probe and dependent RPC evidence are NOT RUN

Register every spawned PID immediately with PID, parent, /proc start time, role, candidate, and namespace in $FIXTURE_ROOT/run/owned-pids.jsonl; signal only a revalidated exact registered descendant or isolated PM2 PID

Install idempotent EXIT, INT, TERM, and HUP traps plus outer timeout; cleanup exact PIDs in reverse order with TERM, five-second wait, then KILL only after revalidation; cleanup failure stops the graph and requires human inspection

Prohibit pkill, killall, pattern signals, tmux kill-server, existing tmux targets, pm2 delete all, pm2 kill, and every PM2 command lacking explicit fixture PM2_HOME; exact isolated process-name deletion and exact registered daemon-PID signaling only

Direct RPC means PM2 script target Pi --mode rpc with proven stdin owner/writer, stdout consumer, ready signal, LF-JSONL command path, EOF/exit propagation, and byte/frame losslessness; PM2 logs are not transport; infeasibility is safe NOT RUN

The conditional PM2 RPC-host wrapper is a separately named candidate: PM2 targets the fixture wrapper, wrapper owns Pi RPC pipes and a mode-0600 runtime-root Unix socket, and PM2/wrapper/Pi responsibilities are separate; it never silently substitutes for direct RPC

JSONL is UTF-8 LF framed, maximum 64 KiB per line, 10000 frames and 8 MiB total per repetition, fail-closed on malformed/oversized input, with sequence/type/count/SHA-256 evidence and explicit extension_ui_request handling

Preregister three measured repetitions per runnable candidate/fault, monotonic nanosecond durations, UTC audit timestamps, 15-second ready deadline, 30-second idle window, 10-second detection deadline, 30-second recovery deadline, 10-second cleanup deadline, and 120-second total repetition deadline

Frozen fault order is clean exit, non-zero exit, rapid crash loop, SIGTERM, and synthetic live-unhealthy sentinel; aggregate medians, inclusive min-max, and n/3; timeouts are censored failures, no selective retries or imputation, and NOT RUN is not comparable

Frozen evidence ordering is lexicographic: safety/cleanup, required-run completeness, lifecycle success, semantic-health success, observability completeness, median recovery latency, then operational-responsibility count; ties remain ties and ordering is not a recommendation

The sentinel keeps the child PID alive/running, emits SYNTHETIC_STALE_CONTEXT on common public stderr, and blocks synthetic ordinary work; no hidden candidate signal; attribute detection/recovery to the actual component and label it a simulation

Evidence uses synthetic payloads, 1 MiB retained-log cap, structured summaries/hashes where raw content is unnecessary, path/control-character scrubbing, and deterministic credential/personal-data scan before staging; any finding fails and blocks commit/push

Terminal output contains evidence scores, ties, uncertainty, blockers, and residual responsibilities only; it must not label adopt, recommended, or winner, authorize migration/rollout, supply production PM2 configuration, or alter defaults; selection requires a separate human-approved issue or ADR
